subject: wet bamboo beside a quiet garden wall
art_direction: 几根湿润竹秆从下部边缘进入，叶尖水珠与灰绿庭院留白相衬。

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Frame a few wet bamboo stems along the lower sides of a quiet garden wall. Fine droplets cling to selected leaf tips, illuminated by soft cloudy light. Keep the nearest green joints detailed and the farther leaves gently blurred. A broad gray-green wall provides natural negative space above, creating a restrained composition with the rhythm of an ink painting. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
